goal: Verify that a user can create a new account, navigate the calendar to the next month, and successfully create and save a new memo with specific content.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
Once logged in and viewing the calendar (initially showing June 2026), click the 'Next month' arrow button to navigate to July 2026.
In the memo input area labeled 'Any thoughts...', type the text 'Remember to buy groceries on the way home.' and click the 'Save' button.
success_criteria: The user is successfully logged in and the main dashboard displays the calendar view.
The calendar header displays 'July 2026' after the navigation step.
A new memo card appears at the top of the feed with the timestamp 'now' and the exact text 'Remember to buy groceries on the way home.'
The input field 'Any thoughts...' is cleared after the memo is saved.
No error messages are displayed during account creation, navigation, or memo saving.
